item.title: Forum Criticism Team - Captain Post
item.content:encoded:
Since this thread was on page 6 of the forum listing with no responses, this is a quick staff reminder to the author that if you haven't yet, you should contact reviewers directly to request feedback as needed.

Please refer to this thread for more information: http://www.scp-wiki.net/forum/t-13282692/how-to-get-more-reviews

If you have already reached out to multiple reviewers and received no reply, notify a staff member for assistance finding a reviewer.

item.title: Requesting greenlight for SCP (Get. Keep. Shelter.)
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): N/A

Page Layout (Optional): Regular page format. (SCP Class, containment procedures, description, maybe a picture)

Elevator Pitch: SCP-XXXX is an organization of about five people who call themselves the 'Get. Keep. Shelter. Organization'. (Basically a really watered-down version of the Foundation with very limited resources)

Central Narrative: (Same as Elevator Pitch) An organization of about five people who rented out a damaged apartment in Oregon and have a radio scanner to monitor nearby calls. They have been in possession of SCP-3108 at some point, but was quickly recovered by the SCP foundation.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The G.K.S. Organization was founded in a different universe where the SCP Foundation was never established, but was rumored of. And they made it through into this universe somehow.

Additional Notes: (this might be similar to Roblox's "SCP: Devolved". But I assure you, I had no idea the devolved thing even existed until after I thought of the GKS Organization
